task: repeat offending — will this resolved offender appear on a new FIR within 180 days?
grain: repeat offender (2+ resolved cases) x observation date

measured.protocol: time-ordered hold-out, last quartile of observation dates, LightGBM at small-data settings
measured.note: The research prototype scored 0.827 at quarterly sampling; this file samples every 30 days. Both beat recency by a wide margin.

fairness: Behaviour and evidence only — counts, dates, districts and heads spanned, gravity. No age, no gender, and no protected attribute; assert_no_protected runs over the feature list before the file is written.
